'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**[[2025 Leland shooting]]
***Six people are killed and 14 others are injured after an individual opens fire at the [[Leland High School (Leland, Mississippi)|Leland High School]] homecoming gathering on a main street in [[Leland, Mississippi|Leland]], [[Mississippi]], [[United States]]. No suspect has been taken into custody. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/oct/11/leland-mississippi-mass-shooting (''The Guardian'')]
*[[British people|British]] musician [[Ian Watkins (Lostprophets singer)|Ian Watkins]] of the band [[Lostprophets]] is killed in [[HM Prison Wakefield]] in [[West Yorkshire]], [[England]], where he was  imprisoned for [[child sexual abuse in the United Kingdom|sexual crimes against children]] and [[bestiality|animals]]. Two men are arrested on suspicion of the murder. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm2d2me0eljo (BBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 ATP Tour]]
**In [[tennis]], [[ATP ranking|world 206th-ranked]] [[Monaco|Monégasque]] player [[Valentin Vacherot]] defeats [[Novak Djokovic]] in the [[Shanghai Masters]] semi-final, becoming the lowest-ranked finalist in [[Masters 1000]] history and the first finalist ranked lower than 200th. He also becomes the first Monégasque to defeat a top 10 player and is set to play his cousin [[Arthur Rinderknech]] in the final.
